title: Starbridge Digital · Company brief
source_note: New scenario draft; the company business awaits confirmation. Other boundaries follow existing material.

sentences.text: Starbridge Digital provides enterprise application implementation and ongoing operations services.
Its external customers are companies purchasing these services.
The assistant directly serves internal new hires, operations staff and administrative support.
Investigate whether the assistant is suitable for an internal pilot, stating scope, safeguards and stopping conditions.
Grace owns the pilot decision and resource approval; a colleague’s opinion is not approval.
Chen represents business needs; Daniel explains system and engineering boundaries.
The assistant handles supported internal enquiries; it cannot grant approvals or perform enterprise-system actions.
Company size, revenue and return on investment have not been supplied and must not be assumed.
